package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

// PinnedCoursePlanRepository is private worker persistence. The existing public
// request repository and DTO remain unchanged. Every write requires a live claim.
type PinnedCoursePlanRepository interface {
	GetPlanningInput(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, error)
	CheckpointPlanningInput(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, time.Time) error
	GetGeneratedCourse(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint, error)
	CheckpointGeneratedCourse(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint, time.Time) error
	GetCourseEnsure(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint, error)
	CheckpointCourseEnsure(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint, time.Time) error
}
